Generated by upstream `mksquashfs` version 4.7.5 (2025/05/25):

```
mkdir -p rootfs/etc
printf 'good file contents\n' > rootfs/good.txt
printf 'unsafe multiarch dpkg list contents\n' > 'rootfs/etc/pkg:arch.list'
mksquashfs rootfs sample.img -noappend -all-root -no-xattrs -mkfs-time 0 \
  -all-time 0 -comp xz -b 4096 -no-progress -processors 1
```

`etc/pkg:arch.list` mirrors a real, common Debian/Ubuntu path (a multiarch
dpkg status/list file, e.g. `gir1.2-gst-plugins-base-1.0:arm64.list`): legal
on Linux, rejected by `validate_name`'s cross-platform `:` check. It exists
to verify that one unsafe-named member is skipped rather than failing the
whole SquashFS open (see `formats::squashfs::open`), so `good.txt` is still
reachable and `etc/pkg:arch.list` is simply absent from the exposed children.
